name: Vincent Zhang
source:
Vince Zhang is a student, Sadie Hotchmitch's pool boy, and one of her flings. He is friendly and laid-back and does not seem concerned with neighborhood politics. He's quite popular among his fellow college students, as evidenced by the fact that his frat brothers and cheerleader friends agreed to help him with Sadie's car wash for free.

[From the [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Vince_Zhang]Wiki[/url]]
